measurement_semantics.current_epoch: capture.metadata.reference_time_s from actual acquisition record; no retiming to annotation sample

evaluation_domain.entities: Only the1-2 decisive declared actors per window selected by the fixed rule below, with a legal visible identity association.
evaluation_domain.space: Full selected actor BODY / full declared future union; do not clip either predicted or GT geometry to an ROI to improve coverage or inflation.
evaluation_domain.time: Current capture reference plus full closed[0,2]s, in10 original0.2s intervals.
evaluation_domain.model_local_scope: Kept as the runtime planning condition; it is not silently expanded or used to crop away a prediction mismatch.

attempt_policy.main: Last valid native response in a window; preserve initial/revision availability and record ID.
attempt_policy.optional_initial_comparison: May report the same visible actor in initial versus revision separately; never adds an independent window or assumes identity solely from ID/pointer equality.
attempt_policy.no_output: NO_NATIVE_OUTPUT, no actor-declaration denominator and no scores; do not call this zero error or zero missing rate.

object_selection_rule.first: Highest-priority interaction/yield/lead object explicitly used by the native decision; if absent, use the closest declared actor relevant to the local intended motion from model evidence.
object_selection_rule.second: Different actor with smallest reported conditional clearance or decisive T2/T4 conflict across all candidates. If unavailable or duplicate, select one object and explain.
object_selection_rule.forbidden: No selection or association by numerical GT error, future GT coverage, or planning success. A failed T1 window is not excluded solely because planning failed.
object_selection_rule.missing: No eligible declared object or essential native metric quantity remains an explicit missing/unassessable slot, never invented output.

identity_review.release_gate: Only after parent reports the corresponding runtime evidence saved/sealed may image/semantic views and GT be read.
identity_review.evidence: Actual referenced images and acquisition IDs, semantic appearance, camera/time, then official nuScenes projection for visible instance identity.
identity_review.freeze: Store selected object IDs/reasons, association status and candidate/instance IDs before computing numerical errors; do not choose nearest GT to reduce error.
ambiguities: crowd or aggregate versus single annotation
articulated bus whole versus per-section annotations
identity_review.disclosure: Historical project images/truth and some actors have been exposed; no claim of a blind or unseen evaluation. New matching should avoid model numerical values where practicable.

comparability_guards: Exact native contract/measurement semantics, output SHA/provenance and actual image/capture references must match sealed records.

Current native position/body and state_time_id must mean box center groundXY at the same reference epoch. Null/legacy/conflicting definitions are NOT_COMPARABLE, no coercion or retrospective definition switching.
GT current state requires same-instance legal annotation interpolation at the exact camera reference epoch, with a bracketing gap<=0.75s; no extrapolation.

Use nuScenes size order width/length consistently. A square BODY or pedestrian authored yaw0 is not automatically a facing-direction measurement. Retain raw parameter difference only when useful; otherwise yaw score=null with reason.
Aggregated facilities or a full articulated bus cannot be forced onto one GT box or silently merged to obtain a score.

metrics.occupancy: Union every retained scenario and all coarse sources touching each original closed interval; never shrink alternatives or infer predictions from velocity.
metrics.residual: Apply original native uncertainty_m total radius exactly once. BODY size is already in polygons. Source/alignment residual components are not added again. The ego1m safety margin is not added to prediction-accuracy geometry.
metrics.gt_surrogate: Reuse existing oriented annotation-linear center/size/shortest-yaw interpolation surrogate, with conservative<=0.02s subsegments. This is not measured continuous future truth.
metrics.incomplete_future: Null, time gaps, placeholder or unbracketedGT retain explicit reasons and interval denominator. No aggregate full2s metric unless all10 intervals are comparable.
metrics.planning_usability: Read original sealed T1/T2/candidate/T3/T4/acceptor/prefix outcomes bound to the exact output; coverage never authorizes planning.

implementation_reuse.minimal_needed_adapter: After release, point BASE/CASES at the new per-case runtime records and frozen actor review, while handling no-output/null/incomparable rows before invoking legacy arithmetic. Keep all results separate from runtime.
known_existing_helper_limitations: Hard-coded old CASES/BASE require a case-specific wrapper.
Existing arithmetic assumes non-null position/body/occupancy, so unscorable slots must be retained explicitly instead of passed into it.
Pedestrian/aggregate yaw and granularity need explicit no-score reasons.
Strict g2_metric planning binder currently expects legacy corridor_v2, so do not use its binder to falsely reject or certify new candidate corridors; copy sealed planner status with source hashes.

prohibited_always: feeding GT identities/numbers/projections back to runtime model or tools
modifying planner/prompt during the frozen batch
calling a real model from evaluation
